name: CACHE Challenge #1
description: A community challenge that prospectively evaluates computational hit-finding/docking approaches against the WDR domain of LRRK2 using experimentally validated targets.
general_score_metric: experimental hit rate / confirmation rate (often reported per-target hit rate or enrichment)
reputation: Respected within the computational chemistry and drug-discovery communities as a rigorous, prospective challenge that links in silico predictions to experimental validation.
notes: Prospective experimental validation reduces retrospective contamination but limits number of targets (small sample size); scores depend on assay definitions; non-LLM benchmark focused on cheminformatics/docking.
